sloka: रावणस्य वधो घोरो यत्नेन महता कृतः ।इदं तु सुमहत्कर्म त्वया कृतमयत्नतः ।। ७.७१.९ ॥
transliteration: rāvaṇasya vadho ghoro yatnena mahatā kṛtaḥ ।idaṁ tu sumahatkarma tvayā kṛtamayatnataḥ ।। 7.71.9 ॥

translations.english: The terrible killing of Ravana was accomplished with great effort, but this very great deed was done by you effortlessly.
